title: Record per-object replication receipts and sync quorum
author: w0F5vYijNonu8kkqLSa_jYY4GIV-Q5HpbxYY525ggm4

events.title: Record per-object replication receipts and sync quorum
events.body:
## Outcome

Show how far each repository, issue, pull request, comment, review, release, and revision has propagated using verifiable receipts rather than optimistic client state.

## Implementation

- Define a signed receipt keyed by object kind, object identifier, revision hash, node identity, seen, verified, pinned, timestamp, expiry, and trust scope.
- Aggregate known, seen, verified, pinned, trusted, stale, and rejected counts with a configurable success quorum.
- Keep receipt replay idempotent and fold shuffled independent receipts deterministically.
- Expose concise per-object status and the evidence timestamp in desktop, browser, mobile, and headless output.
- Protect private object names and participant identities with scoped opaque identifiers.

## Acceptance criteria

- A receipt counts only after its signature, object revision, trust scope, and expiry verify.
- Old receipts never count for a new revision.
- Quorum thresholds produce identical results on every node.
- Private receipts reveal no repository or collaboration title to an unauthorized observer.
- Disconnect, reconnect, repin, corruption, and repair update status without restart.

## Dependencies

Uses deterministic folding from #440 and feeds repository availability in #439 and #466.

## Verification

Shuffle, duplicate, expire, forge, revoke trust, revise objects, disconnect, reconnect, pin, unpin, corrupt, and repair receipt fixtures across every supported object kind.
